# Barbados (BRB) - no sub-national homicide figures found

**Result: nothing found.** No rows.csv.

## Tried
- Barbados Statistical Service (https://stats.gov.bb/, /statistics/data/, /subjects/social-demographic-statistics/): opened; social subjects are labour market, population and visitor arrivals only; no crime/justice series.
- Royal Barbados Police Force (barbadospolice.gov.bb, www.barbadospolice.bb): no connection / proxy 502.

## Limits
The shared web search budget was used up early in this run, so no search-engine queries could be made (no UNODC country notes, health-ministry mortality by parish, news-reported police year-end statistics, or academic papers were reached). Only sites reachable by direct URL were checked. Re-run with search access before treating this as final.

## Retry (retry_within_a, 18 Oct 2026): FOUND (2009-2013)
- web search "Royal Barbados Police Force annual crime statistics murders by division district report" found the IDB report "Crime and Violence in Barbados" (2016), which reproduces RBPF data. Downloaded and read.
- Figure 13: homicides by the 3 police divisions (Bridgetown, South, North), 2009-2013. It is a line chart; the values come from the data labels printed on it (page rendered and read), and they match the text (Bridgetown peak 2010, South peak 2011, North rise 2013).
- Table under Figure 14: homicides by all 14 police districts, 2009-2013 (text table, all rows kept). The source notes which parishes each district serves (kept in the note column) and says "The RBPF was unable to disaggregate to the parish level because several districts serve more than one parish." No division population, so no rates.
- Licence is CC-IGO BY-NC-ND 3.0 (non-commercial, no derivatives) - the owner should check this is compatible with the map.
- Nothing newer than 2013 by area was found; RBPF sites remain unreachable from here.
